problem_text:
A logistics company needs to load packages onto identical delivery trucks. The packages are:
* Package Alpha: weight 37kg
* Package Beta: weight 60kg
* Package Gamma: weight 52kg
* Package Delta: weight 46kg
* Package Epsilon: weight 38kg
* Package Zeta: weight 31kg
* Package Eta: weight 43kg
* Package Theta: weight 53kg
* Package Iota: weight 51kg
* Package Kappa: weight 60kg
* Package Lambda: weight 48kg
* Package Mu: weight 48kg
* Package Nu: weight 65kg
* Package Xi: weight 70kg
* Package Omicron: weight 50kg

Each truck can carry up to 100 kg. Load all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be placed on exactly one truck, and the total weight loaded onto any truck cannot exceed its capacity.
